diagnostics.message: `aws_s3_bucket_policy.access_log_policy` and `aws_s3_bucket_public_access_block.access_log` both only reference `aws_s3_bucket.access_log`, so Terraform applies the PutBucketPolicy and PutPublicAccessBlock calls in parallel with no ordering guarantee. The public access block sets `block_public_policy`/`restrict_public_buckets`, and per the AWS provider docs S3 rejects PUT Bucket policy calls once that block is in force if the policy allows public access, making the result of a same-run apply nondeterministic — and any future drift/re-apply of the policy can fail while the block is in place. `aws_s3_bucket_policy.access_log_policy` should be ordered after `aws_s3_bucket_public_access_block.access_log` so the block is established first and the policy is validated against it.
